integrity: All proper simple games through four players are enumerated from minimal-winning antichains. Public Good is computed in two exact formulations, nucleoli are obtained by an exact rational successive least-core algorithm on every canonical class, the two divergent classes receive direct structural certificates, and all divergent games are canonicalized under player relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for proper simple games through four players and compares weak player rankings rather than numerical distances. If properness is dropped, divergence already occurs at three players.
title: Sharp four-player ordinal boundary for the Public Good index and the nucleolus
